page.title: Audit trail
page.description: Every recorded action across all document reviews — who did what, and when.
page.loadError: The audit trail could not be loaded.

filters.searchPlaceholder: e.g. a storage key or workflow state

system.name: System
system.tooltip: Automated system action — no human actor

annotationCreated.label: Annotation opened
annotationCreated.description: A reviewer raised a new annotation — a comment or issue — on the document.

annotationResolved.label: Annotation resolved
annotationResolved.description: An annotation was marked resolved: the point it raised was addressed.

annotationReopened.label: Annotation reopened
annotationReopened.description: A previously settled annotation was reopened because it needed more work.

annotationDismissed.label: Annotation dismissed
annotationDismissed.description: The review owner or an admin dismissed an open annotation with a mandatory justification (issue #408); the author may reopen it.

annotationClassified.label: Annotation classified
annotationClassified.description: An annotation was categorised — its type and/or priority were set.

placementConfirmed.label: Placement confirmed
placementConfirmed.description: An annotation's position on the page was confirmed on a document version.

placementReattached.label: Placement re-attached
placementReattached.description: An annotation was re-anchored to a new spot — e.g. after a new version shifted the text.

annotationAutoClosed.label: Annotation auto-closed
annotationAutoClosed.description: A terminal review transition (cancelled/finalized) closed a still-open annotation automatically (issue #568).

placementRepositioned.label: Placement re-positioned
placementRepositioned.description: A healthy annotation was deliberately moved to a different passage (free re-attach, issue #562).

workflowTransition.label: Status changed
workflowTransition.description: The review moved to a new workflow status (e.g. Draft → In review).

dueDateChanged.label: Due date changed
dueDateChanged.description: The review's due date was set, changed or cleared.

extractionSucceeded.label: Text extracted
extractionSucceeded.description: An uploaded version's text was extracted successfully and is ready to review.

extractionFailed.label: Extraction failed
extractionFailed.description: Extracting the text from an uploaded version failed; the reason is shown in the details.

storageOrphanDeleted.label: Orphaned object deleted
storageOrphanDeleted.description: An unreferenced object was deleted from storage during a consistency cleanup (issue #523); the object key is shown in the details.

schedulerJobRun.label: Scheduler job run
schedulerJobRun.description: An administrator manually triggered a scheduled maintenance job (“Run now”, issue #524); the job and its outcome are shown in the details.

settingsUpdated.label: Setting changed
settingsUpdated.description: An administrator changed an application setting; the details name the setting and the values before and after. Passwords and other secrets are recorded as changed without either value.

schedulerJobUpdated.label: Scheduler job updated
schedulerJobUpdated.description: An administrator changed a scheduled job’s settings — enabled or disabled it, or toggled its dry-run mode (issue #524).

reviewArchived.label: Review archived
reviewArchived.description: A finalized or cancelled review passed the retention window (or an owner/admin archived it) and left the active lists (issue #576); the outcome it was archived from is shown in the details.

reviewUnarchived.label: Review unarchived
reviewUnarchived.description: An owner or admin restored an archived review to the active lists (issue #576).

reviewPurged.label: Reviews purged
reviewPurged.description: Archived reviews passed the purge retention window and were deleted permanently, including storage objects no other document referenced (issue #577). This is the only surviving record of them — their own audit trail was deleted with them; the details list what went.
